standardDetailAudit.title: Brand Standards Overview
standardDetailAudit.body: WoodSpring standards emphasize kitchen-equipped suites, extended-stay operating models, and practical prototype requirements suited to weekly and longer-stay guests. Owners should review brand participation requirements and development specifications during diligence.

Which prototype applies to this address?
What is mandatory at opening vs. phased 12–24 months?
How do meetings, F&B, or kitchen requirements change PIP?
What technology and loyalty cutover dates are contractual?
What QA fees apply at opening and annually?

standardDetailAudit.title: Technology / Systems
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: PMS, CRS, loyalty, Wi-Fi, and reporting integrations.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm cutover timeline, training, and recurring tech fees.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Mandatory Choice stack beyond headline royalty.
Room count and mix · New build vs. conversion · Prior flag · PIP timing · F&B / breakfast scope · Meeting space · Market tier · Incentive package

standardDetailAudit.title: Guestroom Standards
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Bedding, bath, work area, finishes, and FF&E per prototype.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm PIP scope, procurement, and room mix.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Conversions often need project-specific review.

standardDetailAudit.title: Lobby / Public Space
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Arrival, seating, and brand-appropriate public space.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm layout, FF&E, and conversion flexibility.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Upscale/collection may require higher design investment.

standardDetailAudit.title: In-Suite Kitchen
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Kitchenette or full kitchen with appliances, ware, and ventilation per prototype.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm FF&E, utilities, fire/life safety, and wear reserves.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Weekly housekeeping cadence affects wear.

standardDetailAudit.title: Signage / Exterior
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Brand signage and exterior identity.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm monument, façade, and permitting.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Radisson-family flags have distinct identity packages.
Confirm standards manual vintage and agreement year with Choice development

standardDetailAudit.title: Training / QA
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Opening checklist, Choice University training, and QA inspections.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm inspection fees, remediation, and ongoing QA cadence.
Typical status: Typically Expected
Notes to confirm: Upscale QA burden exceeds economy.

standardDetailAudit.title: Fitness / Pool
standardDetailAudit.body:
Typical consideration: Fitness and/or pool where prototype requires.
Owner planning consideration: Confirm minimum size, equipment, and operating cost.
Typical status: May Apply
Notes to confirm: Economy brands may have reduced requirements.

Conversion PIP scope for WoodSpring Suites should align conversion and new construction where market supports; confirm pip and prototype in disclosure.—sequence FF&E, signage, systems, and breakfast/F&B (if required) with financing and brand approval gates.
